summary: An Abu Dhabi clinic with over 1,000 Google reviews and a named medical director is a strength, but cut off service text and booking on another website appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: Service descriptions appear cut off, for example 'Dental Implant is a material or device placed in and...' and 'Metal Braces are mostly made up of stainless steel brackets...'.
findings.cost: Patients cannot read what you offer and may go elsewhere.

findings.problem: The Book Appointment button appears to send patients to a third party website, and no opening hours or WhatsApp option appear.
findings.cost: Patients who prefer WhatsApp or want hours before booking have no route.
findings.fix: A booking form on your own site, visible hours and a WhatsApp button.

findings.problem: The medical director's name appears in two spellings, the 30 year team claim appears below his own 35 years, and the license label appears in two forms.
findings.cost: Mixed names and numbers weaken trust in a medical brand.
findings.fix: Consistent names, figures and license text.

findings.problem: Four of five dentists appear with only a title and no bio, and only nine of the 1049 reviews appear on the page.
findings.cost: Patients choosing a dentist want to know who will treat them.
findings.fix: Dentist bios with qualifications and a live reviews feed.

redesign: On site booking, hours and WhatsApp.
Consistent details, dentist bios and reviews.
